name: SPW (Semantic Priors in Weights)
definition: A reparameterization method that encodes semantic priors into the weights of an Implicit Neural Representation (INR) model. It uses a Semantic Neural Network (SNN) to extract semantic features and a Weight Generation Network (WGN) to generate INR weights, allowing the INR to implicitly contain semantic information without extra inference cost.
summary: SPW encodes semantic priors into Implicit Neural Representation weights via a pre-trained network, enhancing capacity without increasing inference cost.
